newsitem.title: HONG KONG: SEZ Real Estate hits 10 pct limit-down.
newsitem.headline: SEZ Real Estate hits 10 pct limit-down.

text.p: Shenzhen Special Economic Zone Real Estate & Properties (Group) Co Ltd's B shares plunged HK$0.41 to HK$3.66 early on Tuesday on poor 1996 results announced at the weekend, brokers said.
The shares hit their 10 percent limit-down for the second consecutive trading day.
"People were not expecting SEZ's results to be that bad," an analyst at J&A Securities said. "But I think the shares are now cheap and the price should hover at the current level."
Over the weekend, SEZ Real Estate posted a net loss of 26.34 million yuan in 1996 based on international accounting standards. It gave no comparative figure.

The company, which has half its properties in Shenzhen and the rest in other parts of China and North America, blamed poor sales and a boom-and-bust Shenzhen real estate market, a company official has said.
